about.subtitle: Developer, Student, and Problem Solver
description: I am a 13-year-old motivated developer based in Ottawa, passionate about building clean, efficient, and user-centric applications. My journey in software development is driven by a constant desire to learn and tackle complex challenges.

My coding journey began at age six, sparked by my dad’s introduction to Python. What started as a childhood curiosity quickly evolved into a deep dive into the full-stack ecosystem. After mastering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, I explored mobile development with Dart and Flutter, eventually specializing in modern web frameworks like React, Next.js, Vue, and Nuxt.js. Today, I’ve come full circle by advancing my Python skills into backend architecture using Flask, allowing me to build seamless, end-to-end digital experiences.

Currently, I focus on full-stack development, exploring new technologies and refining my skills through both academic and personal projects. I believe in the power of code to solve real-world problems and create meaningful experiences.
